other.general_negative.title: Vague dissatisfaction with recent updates
other.general_negative.description: Customers say the app became useless or disappointing after an update and express general dislike, often without naming a specific problem. Some cite unrelated boycott or political reasons.
other.general_negative.note: Mixes vague update complaints, restriction complaints, political boycott remarks, and general insults with no specific problem.

usability.other.title: Recent update removed or restricted features
usability.other.description: Customers feel the latest update removed basic player features, added intrusive premium prompts, and restricted skipping and song choice, making the app worse to use.
usability.other.note: Mixes removed player features, premium upsell prompts, and general negative sentiment about the update.

usability.queue_playlist.title: Cannot control playlist playback order
usability.queue_playlist.description: Customers say they cannot play a single song, skip freely, or shuffle through playlists without being pushed through the whole list, and they want more control over queue and playback.

playback.crash_or_wont_open.title: App crashes or will not open
playback.crash_or_wont_open.description: Customers report the app crashes after an update, cannot be opened, or gets stuck on the loading logo screen.

usability.ads.title: Too many ads in the app
usability.ads.description: Customers complain that ads appear too often and are too loud, and that they feel pushed toward premium despite not wanting it.

playback.other.title: Music will not play, including via voice assistant
playback.other.description: Customers say songs do not play, including when started through Google Assistant, where the app says it is playing a playlist but no music starts.

catalog.lyrics.title: Lyrics missing or inconsistently shown
catalog.lyrics.description: Customers report lyrics sometimes do not appear, and that some songs show lyrics while others do not, which they find confusing.

catalog.other.title: Missing songs and limited genre selection
catalog.other.description: Customers say many songs they expect are not available and that certain genres, such as gospel music, are poorly represented.

access.other.title: Cannot log into account and too many ads
access.other.description: One customer says the app will not let them into their account and also complains of excessive ads.
access.other.note: Mixes a login access failure with an ads complaint.

access.password_reset.title: Password rejected at login
access.password_reset.description: A customer reports the app will not accept their password, preventing sign-in.

downloads.offline_mode.title: Offline mode does not work
downloads.offline_mode.description: A customer reports that offline listening is not working.

billing.other.title: Cannot choose songs without premium
billing.other.description: A customer says they cannot listen to the music they want because playback is shuffled, which they find frustrating.

billing.premium_only_feature.title: Song selection and skipping limited to premium
billing.premium_only_feature.description: A customer says that after an update they cannot pick a specific song without premium and can only skip a limited number of songs.

downloads.other.title: Downloads stuck in background
downloads.other.description: A customer says the app keeps getting stuck downloading songs in the background until Spotify is reopened.

playback.connection_error.title: Cannot connect to internet over Wi-Fi
playback.connection_error.description: A customer reports the app cannot connect to the internet when using Wi-Fi.

playback.stops_or_pauses.title: Playback stops halfway through songs
playback.stops_or_pauses.description: A customer says music keeps stopping partway through and does not resume where it left off, starting a new song instead.

usability.ui_change.title: Recent update made everything premium
usability.ui_change.description: A customer feels the latest update locked most functions behind premium, making the app useless to them.

catalog.recommendations.title: Recommendations worse than before
catalog.recommendations.description: A customer says the music recommendations were better previously than they are now.

support.unhelpful.title: Support team treats users rudely
support.unhelpful.description: A customer describes the app's support staff as rude.
